title: Noncured Graphene Thermal Interface Materials for High-Power Electronics: Minimizing the Thermal Contact Resistance
source_location: Supplementary information, page 2, Table S1; main paper Section 3, Equation 2 and Figure 5

conditions.temperature_note: Reported test temperature; paper states heat-source temperature was held constant. A temperature gradient exists across the specimen.
conditions.contact_surfaces: Steel plates supplied with the TIM tester
conditions.method: LongWin steady-state tester; authors cite ASTM D5470-06

contact_convention.basis: Main text states Figure 5 RC equals half the Figure 3 intercept; Table S1 values match Figure 5. SI prose alone is less explicit.
contact_convention.standard_error_note: Both per-interface values derive from the same fitted intercept. Do not combine them as independent measurements.

limitations: Raw thickness-resistance observations are absent from Table S1.
Displayed thickness curves are reconstructions from published regression estimates.
No interpolation between filler loadings is supplied.
Per-formulation measured thickness ranges require Figure 3 extraction.
Standard errors are retained as published; covariance and raw replicate data are unavailable.
The copper-plate roughness experiment in Table S2 contains additional fixture contacts and oil layers and is excluded from this preset dataset.
